summary: Implemented val_df check in _check_spearman_sign_consistency. Previously the val_df parameter was accepted but never read. Now the function computes the Spearman correlation on val_df and blacklists features whose val sign disagrees with the train majority sign (above min_abs_corr threshold).

acceptance_criteria_tested.AC1: Feature with consistent positive train signs but negative val sign is blacklisted
acceptance_criteria_tested.AC2: Feature with consistent positive train signs and matching positive val sign is kept
acceptance_criteria_tested.AC3: Feature with consistent positive train signs and tiny |val_rho| < min_abs_corr is kept
acceptance_criteria_tested.AC5: val_df without label_close_288 column skips val check (no crash)
acceptance_criteria_tested.AC7: All 69 existing tests pass (74 total with new tests)

selector.py: Updated docstring to describe new val_df behavior with audit finding reference
Added val-side sign check in the else branch before stable_features.add(col) — checks val Spearman corr against train majority sign when val_df is provided and has the required columns
test_feature_selector.py: Added TestSpearmanSignConsistency class with 5 tests covering all acceptance criteria
